the-corner-courtyard.blurb: A cafe at 92 Sarat Bose Road with a world-tour menu, open about 8 am to midnight. Small plates, mains and desserts are each reported under ₹400.

tips.expect: An eclectic, easygoing menu pulling from Korea, Italy, Spain, Germany and more.
tips.good: Variety at a fair price, and long hours that work for late dinners.
tips.tip: A good, affordable break on the Bhowanipore and Hazra side.

the-red-bari.blurb: A 90-year-old home at 18 Sadananda Road, Kalighat, turned into a coffee shop, bed and breakfast, and multi-level co-working and events space.

tips.expect: A calm heritage-house cafe. About ₹800 for two.
tips.watch: Reported hours are Tuesday to Saturday 1 to 9 pm and Sunday 11 am to 9 pm, so it is closed on Monday (Ashtami).
tips.tip: A quiet pause near Kalighat metro and the temple.

cotts-and-coco.blurb: A small, beautifully decorated cafe on Jessore Road, Lake Town, specialising in tea. Rated about 4.6.

tips.tip: Near Shreebhumi and the far-north pandals.

bento.blurb: A takeout spot at 56 Jadavpur Central Road, described as the best Korean food near Jadavpur. Rated about 4.0.

tips.tip: A quick Korean meal near the Jadavpur pandals.

coral-bageecha.blurb: A fully vegetarian, tropical-inspired restaurant in Shibpur, Howrah, by chef Prasanta Saha, with lagoon-style outdoor seating and a shisha lounge.

tips.expect: Cafe and fine-dining blended, with reimagined Indian street food. About ₹1,000 for two.
tips.watch: It is across the river in Howrah, so it is not on any pandal circuit.
tips.tip: Only worth the trip if you are on that side of the Ganga.

bengal-dhaba.blurb: A family restaurant in Dakshindari serving Bengali, Chinese and beverages, about ₹1,200 for two.

tips.expect: A relaxed group and family meal.
tips.watch: It is on the east side, near Ultadanga and VIP Road.
tips.tip: Convenient for the Maniktala and Shreebhumi side.

kouzina-mining-co.blurb: A fine-dining restaurant at AD 79, Sector 1, Salt Lake, with a broad menu from Bengali to kebabs. Rated 4.2 from over 3,300 reviews.

tips.expect: A large, themed restaurant open about noon to 10:30 pm daily.
tips.good: The variety, which suits mixed groups.
tips.watch: Popular, so book on Puja weekends.
tips.tip: A good Sector 1 dinner after the block pandals.

harry-s-bistro.blurb: A fine-dining restaurant at AE-329, Sector 1, Salt Lake, serving Continental and Indian food. Rated about 4.4.

tips.expect: A sit-down meal in the AE Block area.
tips.tip: Next to the AE Block pandal.

friends-of-pho.blurb: A 3,500 sq ft pan-Asian restaurant near City Centre II, Rajarhat, with a mini-tempo drinks counter inspired by Vietnamese pho vendors, and billiards and carrom.

tips.expect: Dishes from across Southeast and East Asia in a playful setting.
tips.watch: It is in Rajarhat, away from the Puja circuits.
tips.tip: Only if you are already in New Town.

jungle-safari.blurb: A jungle-themed vegetarian restaurant on the top floor of Mani Square Mall, with life-sized animal figures, a jeep, a treehouse and a waterfall.

tips.expect: An immersive family restaurant with a North Indian and Continental menu.
tips.tip: Near the Maniktala and Phoolbagan pandals.

galawat-salt-lake.blurb: The BE Block, Sector 1 outlet of Galawat, known for galawati kebabs and ulta tawa paratha. Rated about 4.2.

tips.good: The galawati kebab and the unusual paratha.
tips.tip: A good meat-lover's stop in the Salt Lake block pandal area.
